This '''unidentified warrior''' was a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] who fought at the [[Battle of the World-Well]]. He refused to use [[Poison/Legends|poison]] against [[Ganner Rhysode]] because he found it dishonorable, and he knew that it could kill the [[World Brain]].
